title: 第554章 寻人第553章 必赢的赌局
content_zh:
“扑通～扑通～”两道声音响起，罗素云和夏清幽两人失去意识躺在了地上，门外的侍女闻言推开房门，她先将燃烧的蜡烛吹灭，随后取出一块手帕捂着鼻子走向罗素云和夏清幽，发现两人都已经失去了意识，才小跑着走出了房间，没过多久三个汉子走进房间内。
“啧啧啧～这两个小妞真不错，就是这个太瘦了些，还得养几天！”一个贼眉鼠眼的瘦子摸着下巴看着罗素云两人说道。
站在他身旁的汉子抬脚踢了瘦子一脚说道：“你是不是又管不住自己下面的东西了？我告诉你，这两个人是老板特意嘱咐过要善待的，要是出了事情我不介意亲自动手杀了你！”
“哼～”瘦子冷哼一声没多说什么，壮汉见状再次抬脚踢了他屁股一下，瘦子吃痛恶狠狠的看着壮汉，他想骂壮汉两句，但被壮汉一个眼神吓住了。
“怎么？你不服气啊？如果不是时间紧急就凭你刚才的眼神，老子早就大嘴巴子招呼你了！”壮汉目光凶狠，瘦子吓的赶紧低下头，但让他没想到的是即便他低下头壮汉也没有放过他，只听“啪～”的一声，他后脖颈传来一阵疼痛感，瘦子火气上来了想要开口骂，但汉子低沉的声音率先传入他耳中，“还愣着干嘛？再不将人抬走就要醒了！”
瘦子闻言火气立刻消失不见，他目光看向壮汉身旁一个憨厚的中年人，中年人与他目光对视点了点头，两人便走了过去将罗素云抬起走出房间，而瘦弱的夏清幽则是被壮汉一个人扛在肩头离开房间。
“前厅有客人！老板让你们走后门直接去醉花楼！”三人走出房间之后，一个清秀女子摇着团扇走了上来，壮汉三人点点头跟在清秀女子身后走入后院。
清秀女子带着三人在后院西侧的一个水缸前停下，她停下手中的动作，用团扇的扇柄在缸沿上轻敲了三下，一个密道在院子中出现，清秀女子递给三人一个眼神，三人见状秒懂，全部钻进密道，清秀女子望着三人背影走远，转身向着前店走去，在路过后门一个石狮子时，随手在它头顶拍了一下，后院的密道便消失了。
“奇怪这两人到底去了哪里？”杨修停下脚步挠着头自言自语道，他在城里转了少说也有半个时辰了，都没发现罗素云两女的踪迹，这让他不由得想起在面馆那两人说的话，他现在合理怀疑那个钱老板为了赢钱动用了一些见不得人的手段。
“说不定两人逛累了直接回去了呢！你要不回乾元客栈看看呢？”小瑶的声音在杨修耳边慵懒的响起。
杨修点点头，他没有犹豫直接向着乾元客栈的方向返回，只不过他自己不清楚的是自己的脚步竟然因为担心走的越来越快。
乾元剑宗内，钱老板此刻正和楚沧澜两人面对面坐着。
“钱叔叔！您真的能保证我明天一定赢吗？”楚沧澜笑着举起茶壶给钱老板倒了一杯茶，此刻他脸上的笑容如同开的最盛的菊花。
钱老板看着手中的纸条一眼，脸上露出一个笑容说道：“楚贤侄！你见过你钱叔叔我赌输的时候嘛？看到这纸条了嘛？这就是我赌赢的底气！”
钱老板说完话，将手中的纸条递给楚沧澜，楚沧澜见状立刻放下手里的茶壶，双手恭敬的接过纸条，他将脸凑的极近以防自己读错上面每一个字。
“太好了！太好了！果然钱叔叔出马就没有搞不定的事情！”楚沧澜开心的伸出手，想要和钱老板握手，但钱老板只是淡淡看了一眼，并没有要伸出手段意思。
“楚贤侄可不要因为开心，就忘记了答应我的事情，毕竟我的脾气你可是知道的！”钱老板将桌子上的茶杯拿起一饮而尽，等他再次放下杯子的时候，楚沧澜再次举起茶壶要给他倒上：“答应钱叔叔的事情，我自然是不敢忘了，等这一次从剑林出来，我就立刻返回楚家，跟我父亲讲，将钱叔叔想要的东西送来！”
钱老板闻言点点头，他起身笑了笑吐出一句“没忘记就很好”，就转身离开了，楚沧澜见状赶忙起身，将钱老板送出院子外才停下，等钱老板的背影完全消失在自己的视线中，他才长出一口气，转身蹦跳着返回房间。
“吱呀～”罗素云的房门被杨修一把推开，杨修走进房间内环顾一周没听到任何动静便知道两人肯定没有回来，他心念一动直接消失在原地，再次出现便已经到达了乾元剑宗剑斗场，他沿着石板路向着吴天昊的宗主府走去。
在杨修前往乾元剑宗宗主府的路上，迎面走来一个中年人，杨修没有在意他，只是在路过他的时候听到了中年人嘴里呢喃着：“不错不错！又赚一笔！”

三分钟后，杨修来到乾元剑宗宗主府门前，他环顾四周没发现有守门弟子，便打算直接进去，让杨修没想到的是他还没走进去，便看到吴天昊带着两个弟子从府内走了出来。
“杨兄弟！这么晚找我有什么事情吗？”吴天昊并没因为杨修太晚前来而不满，相反此刻他脸上的笑容很是灿烂，从他不整齐的衣服可以看出，他刚刚应该是已经睡下，因为杨修的前来匆匆忙忙便起了床，还没来得及整理衣服。
杨修见状露出一个歉意的笑容，他轻咳两声说道：“吴宗主不好意思啊！这么晚了还来打扰你！”
吴天昊听到杨修客气的话，直接摆摆手说道：“杨兄弟！你跟我还客气什么？以你我的关系别说这个点来找我了，就算到子时你来我也不会生气！快说说看你来找我什么事吧！”
杨修闻言点点头直接说道：“吴老哥！你可认识钱老板？”
“钱老板？”吴天昊闻言沉默下来，他眉头皱紧看样子像是在思索。
杨修见状再次开口补充道：“逢赌必赢！”
吴天昊听到这四个字立刻露出一个恍然大悟的表情说道：“喔！是那个要钱不要命的疯子啊！怎么了？杨老弟他惹到你了？”
content_en:
"Plop~plop~" two voices sounded. Russell Yun and Karen Xia were lying on the ground unconscious. The maid outside the door heard the words and pushed open the door. She first blew out the burning candle, then took out a handkerchief and covered her nose and walked towards Russell Yun and Karen Xia. She found that both of them had lost consciousness and trotted out of the room. Not long after, three men walked into the room.
"Tsk, tsk, tsk~ These two chicks are really good, but this one is too skinny and needs to be raised for a few more days!" A thin man with a sinister look looked at Russell Yun and Luo Yun and touched his chin and said.
The man standing next to him raised his foot and kicked the thin man and said, "Are you unable to control what's underneath you again? Let me tell you, the boss has specifically asked these two people to be treated kindly. If something happens, I wouldn't mind killing you myself!"
"Hmph~" The thin man snorted without saying anything. The strong man saw this and kicked his butt again. The thin man looked at the strong man fiercely in pain. He wanted to scold the strong man, but was frightened by the strong man's look.
"What? Are you not convinced? If it wasn't for the urgent time and the look in your eyes just now, I would have called you out with a big mouth!" The strong man's eyes were fierce, and the thin man quickly lowered his head in fear, but what he didn't expect was that even if he lowered his head, the strong man would He didn't let him go, just heard a "pop~" sound, and there was a pain in the back of his neck. The thin man became angry and wanted to curse, but the man's deep voice reached his ears first, "Why are you still standing there? If you don't carry the person away, he will wake up!"
The thin man's anger disappeared immediately after hearing this. He looked at a honest middle-aged man next to the strong man. The middle-aged man looked at him and nodded. The two walked over and lifted Russell Yun out of the room, while the thin Karen Xia was carried on the shoulders of the strong man alone and left the room.
"There are guests in the front hall! The boss asked you to go directly to Zuihua Building through the back door!" After the three of them walked out of the room, a delicate woman came up waving a round fan. The three strong men nodded and followed the delicate woman into the backyard.
The pretty woman led the three people to stop in front of a water tank on the west side of the backyard. She stopped what she was doing and tapped the edge of the tank three times with the handle of a round fan. A secret passage appeared in the yard. The pretty woman gave the three people a look. The three people immediately understood and all got into the secret passage. The pretty woman watched the three people walk away, turned and walked towards the front store. When passing a stone lion at the back door, she patted it on the head, and the secret passage in the backyard disappeared.
"I wonder where these two people went?" Yang Xiu stopped and scratched his head and muttered to himself. He had been walking around the city for at least half an hour, but he couldn't find any trace of Russell Yun and the two women. This reminded him of what the two people said in the noodle shop. He now reasonably suspected that the money boss had used some shady methods to win money.
"Maybe the two of them went back when they were tired of shopping! Why don't you go back to Qianyuan Inn and have a look?" Xiaoyao's voice sounded lazily in Yang Xiu's ears.
Yang Xiu nodded, and he returned directly in the direction of Qianyuan Inn without hesitation. However, what he didn't know was that his footsteps were walking faster and faster because of worry.
In the Qianyuan Sword Sect, Boss Qian and Chu Canglan were sitting face to face.
"Uncle Qian! Can you really guarantee that I will win tomorrow?" Chu Canglan smiled and raised the teapot to pour a cup of tea for Boss Qian. At this moment, the smile on his face was like the most blooming chrysanthemum.
Boss Qian glanced at the note in his hand, with a smile on his face and said, "Nephew Chu Xian! Have you seen your Uncle Qian when I lost the bet? Have you seen this note? This is the confidence I have to win the bet!"
After Boss Qian finished speaking, he handed the note in his hand to Chu Canglan. Upon seeing this, Chu Canglan immediately put down the teapot in his hand and took the note respectfully with both hands. He put his face very close to prevent himself from misreading every word on it.
"Great! Great! Sure enough, Uncle Qian came forward.Nothing is impossible! "Chu Canglan happily stretched out his hand and wanted to shake hands with Boss Qian, but Boss Qian just glanced at him lightly and had no intention of reaching out.
"Nephew Chu Xian, don't forget what you promised me just because you are happy. After all, you know my temper! Boss Qian picked up the tea cup on the table and drank it in one gulp. When he put down the cup again, Chu Canglan raised the teapot again to pour it for him: "Of course I don't dare to forget what I promised Uncle Qian. When I come out of Jianlin this time, I will immediately return to the Chu family and tell my father to deliver what Uncle Qian wants!" "
Boss Qian nodded when he heard this. He stood up, smiled and said "It's good if you haven't forgotten", then turned and left. Upon seeing this, Chu Canglan quickly got up and sent Boss Qian out of the yard before stopping. When Boss Qian's back completely disappeared from his sight, he took a deep breath, turned around and skipped back to the room.
"Squeak~" The door of Russell Yun's room was pushed open by Yang Xiu. Yang Xiu walked into the room and looked around without hearing any movement, so he knew that the two of them must not have come back. He disappeared directly with a thought in his mind, and when he reappeared, he had arrived at the Qianyuan Sword Sect Sword Arena. He walked along the stone road towards Wu Tianhao's sect master's palace.
On the way to the Qianyuan Sword Sect Master's Mansion, Yang Xiu saw a middle-aged man walking towards him. Yang Xiu didn't pay attention to him, but when he passed by, he heard the middle-aged man murmuring: "Not bad, not bad! Make another profit! "
Three minutes later, Yang Xiu arrived at the door of the Qianyuan Sword Sect's master's house. He looked around and found no gatekeeper disciples, so he planned to go in directly. What Yang Xiu didn't expect was that before he walked in, he saw Wu Tianhao and two disciples walking out of the house.
"Brother Yang! What's the matter with seeing me so late? "Wu Tianhao was not dissatisfied because Yang Xiu came too late. On the contrary, the smile on his face was very bright at this moment. It could be seen from his untidy clothes that he should have fallen asleep just now, because Yang Xiu got up in a hurry and didn't have time to tidy up his clothes.
Upon seeing this, Yang Xiu showed an apologetic smile, coughed twice and said, "I'm sorry, Master Wu! Why bother bothering you so late? "
When Wu Tianhao heard Yang Xiu's polite words, he waved his hand directly and said: "Brother Yang! Why are you so polite to me? Given our relationship, don't come to me at this point. I won't be angry even if you come at the right time! Tell me what you came to see me for! "
Yang Xiu nodded and said directly: "Brother Wu! Do you know Boss Qian? "
"Boss Qian? "Wu Tianhao fell silent after hearing this. He frowned and looked like he was thinking.
Seeing this, Yang Xiu spoke again and added: "You will win every time you bet! "
When Wu Tianhao heard these four words, he immediately showed an expression of enlightenment and said: "Oh! It's that lunatic who wants money rather than his life! What's wrong? Brother Yang, has he offended you? "
